payload.report: A 26-year-old male developed pleuritic chest pain, shortness of breath, and exertional intolerance immediately after acupuncture. Chest CT confirmed air and blood in the right chest cavity with pulmonary hemorrhage, establishing hemopneumothorax. Radiologist analysis directly confirms intrathoracic pathology, and the close temporal relationship to acupuncture strongly supports acupuncture-induced hemopneumothorax. This imaging evidence fully explains the symptoms and refutes cardiopulmonary ischemic events and musculoskeletal/GI pain. Smoking and alcohol history are nonspecific and do not override the causal link. Therefore, the frontier is sufficiently refined, and the diagnosis is acupuncture-induced hemopneumothorax with high confidence.
